nodes.title: Start here · Genereti sketch to local vision
widgets_values:
DEMO: Observe a changing artwork. Genereti Livecode renders an authored orange circle; Local Vision analyzes one queued frame. The viewer displays its description. Rendering continues independently; no automatic per-frame inference occurs.

Requires Genereti public + GeneretiCore.
1. The saved sketch starts moving on open; use editor Run after code edits.
2. Download Qwen3-VL 2B on local vision if missing.
3. Press TOP Run to sample one frame and analyze it. The animation keeps moving while AI works.
4. Change circle hue or motion in the editor and Run again.
For guided steps, scroll down to the walkthrough node and press its Run.
